name: Battle Live! The Idol School Collection
source:
Battle Live! The Idol School Collection is a compilation of short stories that take place in the idol school of Pride Park. 

Episode 1: Battle Live!

A new pair of students, Akiomi and Ayane, transfer to the idol school! While looking around and learning about what it has to offer, this underdog duo starts to feel a little unsure of themselves...

Episode 2: Summer Live

Right before the summer break, Pride Park holds its annual Summer Live, where two students are voted to be the main stars of the event! However, this year's voted duo, Hina and Yuuka, seems to be running into some rough waters.

Episode 3: Halloween Live

Fall is here, and with it comes the annual Halloween Live! Every year, a pair of units is voted to face each other on stage as the main event, and this year's duos — Black Widow and Ace of Spades — start to reminisce about the previous year at Pride Park.

Episode 4: Christmas Live

With the holiday spirit comes the annual Christmas Live! Two units are voted by the fans to perform together upon the holiday-themed stage, but it seems like this year's duo — Joker Game and Saturn Ring — might have some things to work out beforehand...

Episode 5: Valentine's and White Day Live

The two most popular annual events, Pride Park holds its back-to-back excitement with Valentine's and White Day Lives!

The Valentine's Live comes first, and this year's star unit is voted to be Neapolitan! But amidst the lovey-dovey spirit of Valentine's Day, a certain member decides to finally confess his feelings.

A month later is the White Day Live! Kagura's Song is voted as the star unit for the live, and everyone's excited to make it a great one. But the third year's looming graduation makes a certain first year nervous about what's to come...

Episode 6: Festival Live

A new school year has started at Pride Park, and with it comes the annual School Festival! The students put together booths and activities for guests to enjoy, and the Festival Live to close off the event is always a highlight. However, amid all the festival prep, a certain pair of twins reminisces about what brought them to the idol school.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4211370]Steam[/url]]
translation:
战斗直播！《偶像学校合集》是发生在骄傲公园偶像学校的短篇小说集。

第1集：战斗实况！

一对新学生秋臣和绫音转学到偶像学校！当环顾四周并了解它所提供的功能时，这对失败者组合开始对自己感到有点不确定……

第2集：夏日现场

暑假前夕，Pride Park举办一年一度的Summer Live，两名学生被选为活动的主角！然而，今年的投票二人组希娜和优香似乎遇到了一些麻烦。

第3集：万圣节现场

秋天来了，一年一度的万圣节现场也随之而来！每年，都会有一对组合被选为在舞台上对决作为主要赛事，今年的二人组——黑寡妇和黑桃王牌——开始回忆去年在普莱德公园的情景。

第4集：圣诞现场

伴随着节日气氛而来的是一年一度的圣诞现场！粉丝投票选出两个组合在节日主题舞台上一起表演，但今年的二人组——《小丑游戏》和《土星环》——可能有一些事情需要提前解决……

第5集：情人节和白色情人节直播

作为两项最受欢迎的年度活动，骄傲公园连续举办情人节和白色情人节活动！

情人节现场先行，今年的明星单位被票选为那不勒斯！但在情人节的甜蜜气氛中，某成员终于决定表白自己的感情。

一个月后就是白色情人节现场！神乐之歌被选为现场表演的明星组合，每个人都为能成为一场精彩的表演而感到兴奋。但第三年毕业的临近让一年级的某个人对即将发生的事情感到紧张……

第6集：节日现场

普莱德公园新学年开始了，一年一度的学园祭也随之而来！学生们布置了摊位和活动供来宾享受，而活动结束时的节日现场表演始终是一大亮点。然而，在节日准备期间，一对双胞胎回忆起他们来到偶像学校的原因。
